public_basis.part9: Market Microstructure in MQL5 (Part 9): Pullback Quality

microtrend.formula: (alignment*0.40 + price_position*0.40 + slope*0.20) * volume_boost, with contradiction penalty 0.3

pullback.source_warning: composite score is a sizing/quality scalar; no forward-return validation in source

C01_BINARY_HEALTHY.condition: Part-8 fixed-threshold binary signal +/-1 AND Part-9 PBQ_HEALTHY on the same completed M1 bar

C02_PERSISTENT_HEALTHY.condition: C01 plus Part-8 persistent_dir over 3 consecutive completed bars equals binary direction

C03_PERSISTENT_SHALLOW.condition: Part-8 persistent_dir equals binary direction AND Part-9 quality is PBQ_STRONG or PBQ_HEALTHY

timing.entry: first executable P75 tick at/after decision edge
timing.chart_price_proxy: P75 bid, matching MT5 forex chart-side convention

selection_rule: advance only preregistered source-grounded profiles passing supply/economic gates; rank strong survivors by direct net then official wins then trade count; no parameter rescue
restrictions: no composite-score binary threshold invented after results
